exposure: Fewer than four antenatal care visits
cohort: 521 women who gave birth in the 12 months prior to the study in a rural community
finding: Non-utilization of postnatal care was found to be 75.4% in the area, with normal delivery, fewer than four antenatal care visits, inaccessibility to transportation, and poor knowledge of postnatal care identified as factors enhancing non-utilization.
mod_finding: Normal delivery was identified as a factor enhancing non-utilization of postnatal care.
